name: print-social-metro-screen-posters-in-blue-glass-and-silhouette
title: Three digital-screen posters on brushed steel: blue ribbons, profile silhouette, glass steps
whatItIs: Three vertical screens in a steel-panelled wall. Left: pale blue folded ribbon shapes with 'Your money Your control'. Centre: a faded silhouette of a man's profile with 'Move money. No friction.' Right: deep blue radial light and glass steps with 'Spend smarter Live easier'.
whatItMeans: Calm and premium; abstract blues and short slogans suit commuters glancing.
techniques: Use abstract 3D forms in brand blue as hero art.

Show posters in an urban environment.
